How It Works

Investigate the decision before committing to it.

TradeBridge starts with the commercial unknown, builds a defensible evidence base, attacks the thesis with counterevidence, and stops where another specialist's competence begins.

01

Define the question

We establish the decision, scope, constraints, and what evidence would change the answer.

02

Build and challenge the evidence

We investigate supporting evidence, contradictory evidence, provenance, unknowns, and decision architecture.

03

Return a usable decision

You receive a concise commercial-intelligence packet showing what survived, what did not, and what still requires verification.

Referral Partners

Clear boundaries make better handoffs.

TradeBridge does not try to become the attorney, engineer, recruiter, accountant, automation builder, or execution agency. We investigate the commercial decision and hand off when the problem crosses into another specialty.

TradeBridge → specialist

The commercial decision is clear. Execution becomes the problem.

When our work establishes which outside opportunity deserves pursuit but the next step belongs to another discipline, we stop and make the boundary explicit.

Specialist → TradeBridge

The execution request arrives before the commercial question is settled.

When a specialist's client still does not know which market, customer, partner, supplier, geography, or opportunity deserves commitment, that is where TradeBridge can investigate first.

About TradeBridge

Commercial intelligence for businesses without an internal intelligence team.

TradeBridge helps established businesses investigate important external commercial unknowns before management commits scarce resources. Our scope can include customers, prospects, markets, competitors, suppliers, sourcing, distributors, channels, geographies, pricing, partnerships, commercialization, and opportunity qualification.

We do not fill gaps with guesses. Unknown remains unknown until verified. Signal is not opportunity. Evidence outranks hierarchy. Scope may change; the standard does not.

Contact

Bring us the commercial question.

If your business is deciding where to sell, who to pursue, which partner or supplier to trust, where to expand, or whether an opportunity deserves resources, TradeBridge can investigate the decision.
